veranderings.voor: die oorblyfsels van hulle dorpies is
veranderings.na: die oorblyfsels van dié mense se dorpies is
veranderings.rede: The nearest plural noun before 'hulle' is 'argeoloë', so the pronoun can be read as the archaeologists' villages; naming the newcomers removes the ambiguity and also gives the next sentence's 'Hulle' a clear antecedent.
